issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. There is no file or network access, no pasted answers and no use of test labels. StandardScaler, RF, LGBM and LR are all fitted on x_tr only. Ranking the test predictions inside the fold is fine because AUROC only uses ranks.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The candidate adds a Morgan RF+LGBM+LR blend as one more ranked member, built from train_sets[0]/test_sets[0]. I assume these are the Morgan features, but the diff doesn't show it. The new member gets the same weight as each existing XGB member. Seeds are passed to RF and LGBM. LR is deterministic.

The numbers agree. Candidate 0.0937 vs incumbent 0.0906 (2 runs) means the candidate is 0.0031 worse. I took the noise sd of the difference as 0.0049*sqrt(1/1+1/2) ≈ 0.0060, which gives z ≈ -0.52. The harness gives -0.507; the gap is likely rounding in the means. Either way this is within noise or slightly worse, so the provisional reject stands.
Minor: this adds three models and more code for no measured gain. Under the 'simpler is better' rule it isn't worth it even if a replicate came out level.
